run_detect_text_cli: run detect_text_cli to detect bounding boxes in PDF or image files using the Surya detection model
run_detection_predictor: run DetectionPredictor to generate text bounding box predictions on a list of images
run_cliloader: run CLILoader to load images from a file or folder and configure detection output settings
run_draw_polys_on_image: run draw_polys_on_image to draw detected bounding box polygons onto an image for visualization
run_cliloader_parse_range_str: run CLILoader.parse_range_str to parse a comma-separated page range string into a sorted list of page numbers
